name: hydra-triage
description: Reachability-based CVE triage over a HydraDB call graph. Tells you which flagged CVEs are actually exploitable in your code, not just present in your tree.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/vulndb && cp src/vulndb/vulnerable-functions.json dist/vulndb/vulnerable-functions.json && mkdir -p dist/incident && cp src/incident/event-stream-2018.json dist/incident/event-stream-2018.json
scripts.selftest: node .selftest/build.mjs && node .selftest/run-config.mjs && node .selftest/run-safe-static.mjs && node .selftest/run-scan-input.mjs && node .selftest/run.mjs && node .selftest/run-incident.mjs && node .selftest/run-gate.mjs
